correctness.rationale: Walsh decomposition yields spectral shell ranks 1 at the two endpoints and 2 or 3 at each interior level. The coordinate-swap parity argument proves all non-antipodal triple ranks are 3; antipodal phase proportionality proves rank 2 otherwise. Positive loss makes the orthogonal bright sector strictly dissipative. Independent modular Walsh and Krylov computations passed 1388 finite rank tests; these are corroborative, not the infinite-dimensional-parameter proof.
